cards.public_summary: Jeff McLane reported mixed results for Jalen Hurts and the Eagles offense during the team’s 15th training-camp practice.
cards.evidence:
My #Eagles practice observations from Day 15 of training camp:

*DeVonta Smith, Makai Lemon return to WR arsenal

*Results mixed for Jalen Hurts and Co.

*Jalyx Hunt and Moro Ojomo dominate — again

Much more here: https://t.co/wrvF50aenR
cards.commentary: This is a minor practice-performance flag rather than a role or health update. Mixed camp results alone do not materially change Hurts’ fantasy outlook.
cards.author: Jeff_McLane
